note: CardMachine is the model of nova-tools' deleted Lua card machine (02_card_move.lua), kept because CardISA EXTENDS it; it is not the machine lifecycle.go runs. SprintTables is the machine lifecycle.go runs, one action per move of the inventory in docs/SPEC-SPRINT.md section 3 (every place the code writes a primary's column): six states and the lawful moves (Moves, with PR #96's working -> waiting), the named needs as a variable (NeedsSet: needs set and a brief edit's DEPENDS-ON, held to the cycle check), waivers, sentinels and their release, the fleet side (Start, Take, Finish, Withdraw for every working -> ready cause, FleetDown, FleetUp; rework and redo deal a work card), PR #96's NeedsWithdraw and NeedsWait, drop and remove (a removed landed card keeps its outcome), and the reads and the accept. It proves TypeOK, NoNeedCycle, Rule11 (review, merging, landed), AcceptHeld, NeverAcceptBroken, NeverReadByItsWorker, NoCardLostOrTwice, MovesOnlyByTable, ReadyToWaitingOnlyByInsertOrNeeds, WorkingToWaitingOnlyOnNeeds, NeedsWithdrawalWaits, LandedIsFinal, NeedsLandFirst, NeedsHeldIntoWorking and WorkingOnAnUpMember, each rule but TypeOK with a reversed witness (insert, needsany, needless, reviewneeds, dealunmet, cycle, downkeeps, shortaccept, acceptbroken, ownread, skip, unland, comeback, withdrawmet, withdrawready). Open and named: a taken card given a need not landed can finish ok before the tick withdraws it (the model's NeedsSet takes a new need only on a dealt, untaken card). The refmodel's pending-operation fence (D1: Free) is left out; refmodel's Accept demands two readers where the code allows one for flash (v1.2.13 cleanups). Outside the module: streams and stream moves (MoveCards), admission after the start, merge and return in the merge table, crash and repair.

CardISA holds the instruction set of docs/SPEC-ISA.md: one Wait over an operand (resolving a non-wait card alone), a wait card landed by its release (IsaLandEvent, a waiting wait card with released) and never dealt, a result per kind, and LandsOnlyByTable (a card lands from merging, or from waiting a wait card). Four reversed witnesses: doubleland, wrongbase, waitfirst, landanywhere. The upper moves (ready->waiting, working->ready, review/merging reworks) are SprintTables' cards, not this module.

AttemptsEpochs holds the epoch and clear (n, the restore marker, the per-epoch tables, a step's pin, clear as the CAS, a late writer refused as stale, a second concurrent clear, with the noepochcheck witness) and a card's attempt, generation and redeals: Deal cuts a new attempt's work card (attempt + 1, generation 1, refused when it exists already), Redeal deals a withdrawn card again (the same attempt, generation + 1, a redeal counted only when a take of it ended, sprint.FieldTakeEnded), the other generation steps (a stop-return, the live reconcile, a gone lane) step the generation with no redeal, a report naming a generation that is not the live one is refused (StaleGenRefused), and no two launches share an attempt, a generation and an epoch (SuffixUnique, the branch per launch), with the keepgen and nogenguard witnesses. The redeal cap's judgment and the tier ladder are DirtyTick's (RedealsAreEndedTakes, RedealBoundHolds) and SprintRules' (LadderClimbs); the crash cut between AdvanceEpoch and SettleEpoch is a v1.2.14 candidate named in the module and not modelled.

ReadCards holds the read cards (the code asks a card's reads together): MaxReadGen 2, the needed count 0, 1 or 2 (ReadsNeededIn), the merging-short-of-reads return (ShortReadsBack), and one reversed witness.

ReadsByRoom now asks a card's reads together (the interim parallel rule of 2026-10-06) with a reversed witness NoAskWhileBroken; the code still counts a re-ask when the reader hands the read back, draws a read from the tier's index, and keeps a begun read on a reader that went away, and zeroes a reader's room under NoRoom or a reader off (readers.go room), none of which the module models (tla/README.md).

Land holds the batch, the check of the caller's epoch before any git, the report fenced to the epoch land read, a refusal of the card's own head reworking it (or reviewing it at its bound) with the stream going on and the lander's own failure stopping it (2026-10-06), and seven reversed witnesses. Land's Repair now skips sentinels, held cards and pushed-unreported cards as check.go Rule6Merging does (Sentinels and HeldCards are nonempty CONSTANTS in the control instance, NoSentinelInQueue and NeverHeldBack are checked, and PushedNeverSentBack extends to Repair with the repairmarked and repairheld witnesses). land.go still does that check. Catalog rows and generated ledgers regenerated inside a batch, the ancestry check named by land-verify-landed-ancestry, repair's atomicity (Rule6Merging reads a snapshot and never re-checks LandingMarked) and the pending fenced operation finish (pending-fenced-op) are not in the module. LandPass holds the pass over several streams (2026-10-07): the merges in parallel up to a width, the landings one at a time in priority order, a pushed tip that passed its own gate, the combined gate, or a clean merge of disjoint files, a landing never lost by the merge after, a collision refusal that stops no stream, a tip recorded as gated only when a gate saw its whole tree (the next pass gates a disjoint merge), a re-merge that merges fewer heads or none, and (2026-10-11) a red gate that blames one head, lands the prefix before it and reworks the head with the stream going on, returns the batch to queued when no head is blamed, and lands the batch whole when the tree tests read none of its files, with NoHeadPastItsBlame and eight reversed witnesses, and the liveness that with every tree green every batch lands; landpass.go runs those two phases. Since 2026-10-10 the landings go as each batch is built (NoHeadOfLine, the inorder witness), each stream's deadline on its own clock from its slot, and LandBisect holds a red batch's blame by bisection (at most ceil(log2 n) gates) and its refusals: a batch is refused only on a bench fault or an environment refusal (a missing tip, a failed diff or reset, a cancelled gate, a remote bench that never ran the gate; RefusedOnlyByBenchOrEnv), with four reversed witnesses.

SeatHealth holds the seat generation and a friend's health: her row can be deleted (Clear), rung 5 of the stall ladder writes it outside NotHealth (Rung5Down), and FriendEvidence is up on a wake ping answered or the beat's proof, never a raw beat, with seven reversed witnesses. Her beat's down word (SaysDown) and a card finished (FriendFinishWindow) are still outside; the three evidence windows are one DownAfter.

Holds holds a stream's hold, stop, resume and reopen: holdStream and unhold (a hold withdraws the stream's ready cards, and its working ones with --return), a deal that refuses a held stream while a stopped stream still deals, the cross, red, conflict and rejected stops, a refusal of the card's own head that stops nothing, Resume (a cross stop waits for the needed card to land, a red stop needs --did), TickResume's cross resume, and reopenAdd past a landed stop, with one reversed witness (resumeearly); and the no-stall rule (held.go Unheld): a stop raises an open judgment, NoSilentStall says a stopped stream has an open judgment or is the coordinator's hold, and Progress (a card the coordinator does not hold eventually lands) under fairness of the coordinator's answers, with the reversed witness silentstop; and now a held card, a sentinel and its release (WaitOf in held.go, Resolve, Release and SentinelSet in steps_sentinel.go, the cut release in sentinel.go): one stream whose line is [a, S, b] (S a plain or a cut sentinel) and one held card h, proving HeldMovesOnlyByRelease, OnlyCoordinatorReleases, CutNeverWaives and SentinelLandsOnlyWhenWaitsUnderWay, with two reversed witnesses (resolveheld, workerreleases). DirtyTick's pump still auto-lands sentinels (stale); a held member stays outside the module.

SprintRules holds twins, the attempt bounds, the read-broken rule (a finding inside PATHS reworked with it at the brief's bound, a file outside PATHS widened in place at most MaxWidens=3 times), the harness-fault rework and the late report (a LAND or a HOLD) that finishes a failed attempt, a late report for a stale attempt refused (Part answers, PartsAgree with the reversed witness answersmind), the late rule, the base gate and the idle alarm, in the same commit as the late-rule code; Part episodes holds a hard pin released past its bound (stops.go PinReleased), the cannot-ask judgment once a wait, and a rule's answer consumed by the attempt it started (2026-10-10). Part judgments holds the three judgment rules (judgment_rules.go ruleFriendTake, ruleReadLate, ruleHoldNeed) with the reversed witness takestarted (FriendKeepsStarted). The conflict rule (ruleConflict/ruleRedo) and the brief-defect rule (ruleBrief) still have no Part, and the read-broken rule reworking the same finding inside PATHS on every attempt with no attempt bound (rules_read.go:99-113) is modelled bounded, never read again once fixed, a v1.2.14 candidate, so the row is partial.

Level holds the machine rebalance at the start of a tick: levelTo, a gap of at least two, both end guards, and five reversed witnesses. steps_work.go cites the module. Friend level in internal/sprint/friend_level.go, within a class, and the readers' level are outside the module, which says the readers' level is not modelled. No card named for this map owes friend level, so it is named here rather than as a row with an empty owed_by. The avoid set also holds bench and launch refusals, and the callers are the level op and fleet up's comeUp.

RouteIndex models the counter, the first flag and its preferred draw (FirstPreferred, with the nofirst witness), the per-member harness draw (NeverUnlaunchable per member, with the harnessblind witness), the FieldRoutes exclusion on a new attempt, a resting route skipped as an unserved one (Rested), a read's avoid set (Avoid) and its tier collapse (ReadTier, pro to flash), a redeal, a pinned card, and a read drawn from the reader tier's index beside work cards. Still outside the module: a provider at its concurrency budget is not skipped (the deal draws one anyway), and the coordinator's fallback that deals a rework on a full provider.

ServerLanes models the control line (sprint.ControlLine) and the reader-card lease: a batch takes the next ticket and is served first come, first served; the tick takes the line at its turn; a gone caller's ticket is served and handed back; read --begin (a line verb) begins the lease, a served queue renews it (errors ignored), a lease not renewed lapses, and restart keeps the live and takes back the lapsed. Five reversed witnesses (beat on the line, read on the line, a gone write still run, the tick queued like a batch, and norenew); FCFS, TickWaitsOneTurn and LiveLeaseNeverTakenBack hold.
check.go computes violations from a snapshot, so a break is found. Nothing in this tree stores a violation as found, then answered, then cleared, and no module holds that lifecycle.

WorkImport holds an issue under import and a repository's sync, with import and verify each scoped to a subset of the repositories: the import writes only its scope's issues and records the scope in the tree (:scope), verify reads the tree's own scope by default and refuses a --repo outside it, so a verify never reports done outside the import's scope; six reversed witnesses (noreceipt, stale, external, noreopen, partial, scoped). The receipt and Close/Export are design-only. The command guards (an org-wide dry run, an existing output directory, a verify of two trees, later refusals) are outside the module.

DirtyTick holds the tick as shaped on 2026-09-30, plus a member's held and draining status, a run state and the stop, with NeverDealtToDraining, NotAskedOfHeldOrDraining and StoppedMovesNothing. The code deals up to twice a member's width and rebalances the fleet table and the readers table at the start of every tick, and the model has no such step (tla/README.md).

CoordinatorWake holds the batched wake (one wake fires every bus ask the look read, naming three and counting the rest), the filtered message that moves the cursor without a line, and the level events (a judgment, a stop, a friend down) that set and clear between looks; NoLapse is over bus events alone, and LevelSeenWhileItHolds is a level event that holds a whole window waking a run unless it clears first. Three reversed witnesses: nocursor (AtMostOnce), skip and batchdrops (NoLapse), in the same commit as watchwake.go.

NoRoom holds a member's word from Room every tick (draining or not), its beat to the store, and the two planners that read it: the tick's deal and the fleet verbs outside the tick; and the drain the beat says (--draining, Beat.Draining): no deal to a draining member, its dealt cards not taken returned by the level, and a reader row's machine (held or draining) asked nothing, its reads asked and not begun taken back only when another reader can take it (a taker, sweepReads); and the probe gate (known only on a passed probe, steps_work.go fleetStepPlan) that the deal and the ask read (NeverDealtUnknown). Ten reversed witnesses (drainskip, fleetblind, tickblind, drainblind, readblind, silentdrain, noreturn, noreadreturn, probeblind, notaker). The word's staleness (NoRoomNow on a beat's age), a reader's own drain (modelled as its machine's) and the read ask's reader states are outside the module; so is pkg/member never sending --draining (a fork drift for v1.2.13's contraction).

RetireAbsent holds the tick's retirement of a fleet row whose machine record is gone from the inventory: sprint.TickRetireAbsent plans the fleet sync's own removal before the deal (internal/sprint/fleet_retire.go), the store's tick reads the inventory (cmd/nova-sprint/fleetsync.go inventoryMachines -> store.Inventory -> config.Widths, no new store) and deletes the row and the reader reader-<old> DropMembers returned after the answered read (internal/sprint/store/tick.go). RecordsKeepRows is the state invariant (a recorded machine keeps its row) and FleetRowsMatchConfig/LiveRetire the leads-to that the tick closes the gap; a failed read and an answered read that names no record both retire nothing (the code is stricter than the model's failed-read guard). One reversed witness: MCRetireAbsentBroken retires a recorded row on a failed read, the counterexample to RecordsKeepRows.

The requests-per-minute window per model and the concurrency leases per provider, taken by every caller through the server before each model request (WATCH/MULTI, no scripts): NeverOverRate, NeverOverConcurrent and InFlightHeld (each while every renewal inside its bound succeeds; the renewal is best-effort, a renewal not written lets the lease lapse), AbortedWriteReleasesSlot (a lost race releases the slot), Progress, StalledIsGranted (bounded demand), SlotReclaimed; reversed witnesses race (an unguarded write), norenew (the renew-failure case), noexpiry, keepslot (a kept slot after an aborted write). The deal-side fallback and the take gate count fleet cards (Go tests, internal/sprint/rate_budget_test.go), not this module.

RoadmapEntry holds an entry of docs/roadmap.sexp and docs/fixes.sexp under add, remove, pull, note, done and Save's four writes: every group and release keeps an entry, every record names a group or release that is there (a scheduled note's :release is read and not checked), done is final, a shipped release is frozen, a save across the files writes the destination's data first and never loses an entry, and within a file the data is written before its page, with five reversed witnesses (lastchild, sourcefirst, pagefirst, movedone, shippedmove). Note on a done fix or a shipped release is not modelled: the code's Note has no open guard, so its fix card (a v1.2.14 candidate) brings it.

SeatHook holds the server-owned subscription, the challenge answered over it, the cadence and its bound, the record's Live from the proof and a re-challenge's own bound (so the gate refuses when Live lapses even with a challenge inside its bound, up to one look period early), delivery and acknowledgement, drop, unhook, the next server's start rewriting a dead server's record gone (ServerStart), and the gate, with eight reversed witnesses, in the same commit as hook.go. It leaves out the replacement of an open hook (an end and a hook), the cumulative ack, and the record writes in look() and end() (a failed write is logged and the pushes still go, a failed end write is logged and the owner still told: v1.2.14 candidates), as its header says.

LiveRuns (v1.2.6, 2026-10-10) holds working against the rows' live sets, RUNNING and STOPPED: the tick's reconcile returns a working card its row's fresh live set has not named for the grace since its take or last sighting (WorkingIsLive), a STOP debt entry owns its card only until its return receipt (StopMarkerIsWorking, OwnedLeavesWithReceipt), a held finished report is never returned and does not hold the start back (NoReportLost), a running child's card is never returned (NoRunReturned), a return settles its entry off the debt so clear reads a debt that is owed alone (DebtIsOwed), and no working card of a legacy row (a worker from before v1.2.6, whose beat carries no live set) is returned by the reconcile (LegacyNeverReturned); a take names its card in the live set only at the member's next pass, and the grace from the take covers that lag. Seven reversed witnesses (the v1.2.5 STOPPED tick, a legacy row reconciled as an empty set, the grace dropped, the debt by id, a live set without held reports, a stale beat read as an empty set, a reconcile that leaves its receipt in the debt) and one reachability case. The friend daemon's live set is nova-friend's (nova-tools) and is not in this tree.

Adopt holds the seat play as a window: PreCheck's two refusals (no library, a read error) change nothing before the window, then the play's five steps in order (stop, migrate, swap, reinstall, restart), the post-load check and the rescue, with the migration one-way (MigrationIsOneWay) and two reversed witnesses (keep-new fails RefusedLeavesOld, undomigration fails MigrationIsOneWay). The three in-window refusals that exit 1 without reading the old library back (adopt_play.go:236-246, :262-266, :247-249) and the rescue's failed_when: false are v1.2.14 candidates, outside the module.
The digest reads the open set.

A fault is a presence down marked held_by=fault with fault_since, set by the beat-lapse down alone, lifted by faultClear after a beat and an ok finish; a harness fault and a failed take hold by HeldByEnv, and the coordinator's, sync, adopt and env marks stand behind the one person value, all outside. The model's ok reset is stricter than faultCleanFinish's second-resolution stamp compare, which counts a finish in the hold's own second.

Each card carries a dealt age and a pin, a Running job counts as taken and Return runs only for an up friend; DealtNoMoreHolds is restated as the action property and PinnedNeverReturned has the returnpinned witness. The friendUnstartedLevel defect (friend_start.go:249) is outside: a v1.2.14 candidate, and the bench TLC records are owed.

The four friend moves that read cardLeft (friendLevel, friendUnstartedLevel, reclaimUnit, friendCouldTake) are one FriendMove action reading wleft and left; Rework has the brief-defect early return; CapDeal places the card working on her row. Reversed witnesses NoLeft, MachineLeft, CapLeft, RuleLeft and LevelLeft. friend_start.go and friend_deal.go do not cite the module yet.
The TICKLATE write and the delivery can fail after w.last moved; the model's Restart always recovers it.
The mark, the ids and the chunks are separate trips; entries are keyed by epoch.

ProviderBudget holds the environment-fault hold and the probe gate: probe is the caller's own word (--probe), trusted as the code trusts it, with a reversed witness for every declared witness; the drain (tla-noroom-admission-by-probe) and provider funds (tla-provider-funds) are outside the module.

ReaderTiers holds the ask by tier (freeReaders, ReadsWanted, readerServesTier): a fleet reader's empty tiers cell reads flash alone while the store holds routes and every tier with none, a friend's reader (ownModelReader) reads its own model's tiers, an empty cell every tier, four tiers, Need from ReadsNeededIn, and a card's reads asked together; Eligible no longer filters on tier, so NoReadOutsideTier is a real check. Two reversed witnesses: BugIgnoreHeld fails NoReadToAHeldReader, and BugEmptyReadsAll (a fleet empty cell reads every tier while routes exist) fails NoReadOutsideTier.

The ReadyMax bound, per-card holds, the stream, friends, brief, launcher and width causes and timed rests are in; the sentinel's own reason and the balance figure in the reason key (ready_over.go:25-26, a v1.2.14 candidate) are outside.
An open coordinator rest, a take launched before the mark, the window reset on a provider rest.

RateBackoff (added by the v1.2.14 card a-rate-limited-refusal-never-fails-the-cardc; internal/sprint route_rest.go RestsDue and steps_work.go rateLimitedReturned) models a take a provider ends rate-limited: the card returns to ready unspent, and the route backs off Min(2^(k-1), Cap), the backoff ending by itself; RateLimitSpendsNoRedeal, BackoffBounded and BackoffEnds, with the reversed witnesses MCRateBackoffBrokenSpend and MCRateBackoffBrokenNoCap. The v1.2.12 rows pass tla-coverage-rows-for-every-nova-sprint-module predates the module, so this row records it here.

SprintEvents is the state machine of layers 3 to 8 of design/EVENT-DRIVEN-TICK-v2.1.md, with the scenarios in MCSprintEvents.tla and the larger runs in tla/sprintevents-bench/ (tla/README-SprintEvents.md). It predates the v1.2.12 rows pass, which named it in the card-lifecycle row; this row names it alone. A bench run of section 5's instance to completion is still owed.

StallLadder holds the friend stall ladder: dealt and taken stamps as a sign of life and stopped time excluded from the idle clock, "started" read as the code does (a progress stamp marks the card started), the rung climbing only upward and resetting only at 0, and NoStampedTaken with the takestamped reversed witness. The seat's friend-health observations and the wake lane's delivery are outside the module.
A tidy marker older than TidyStale is taken as ended; stream money is outside.

Leases keyed by <<card, gen>> (stopOwned) with the NoStaleGenOwned invariant and its byid witness; readers-table leases modelled (MCStopReturnReaders checks the reader model: STOP captures the reading column, and a read is returned asked at gen+1 by the owner's own stop-return, never by the beat -- its own still-open read counts in the stop-returns count); START's held-report guard and the pre-upgrade record (MCStopReturnPreUpgrade, Broken = "preupgrade": no stop-issued flag, no debt list, START refuses while a live lease remains); clear stops first, then reads the current work/read leases and refuses while any is live, checked by ClearEnabled and ClearNeverWithALiveLease with the clearblocked witness; a beat gone stale between the read and START is a v1.2.14 candidate, not modelled.
Set, cancel, raise once, restart; the due time counts running time and must be strictly after now.

The deal is gated on tiers, the preference order, the take-back memory and the pin release are modelled, with the anytier and dealback reversed witnesses; the rebalance's one-tier-up overflow and cheapest-first order are not modelled.
Start, Stop and Start fence, runseq and NoStaleRunCommit (with a reversed witness); still no epoch refusal, no StartsWork/ReportsWork/RequiresStopped fences, no stopped drain.

GateRing holds the gate bench's ring: the hashed start slot, the per-pass skip record (SkipAfter), a refusal stepping to the next slot, the lane always given back, and the local fallback refused as a remote-bench unavailability whenever another member is configured; two reversed witnesses. The gateSlot record names the hashed start slot, not the slot that ran (landgo.go), and the lane-grant wait (takeGateLane on hosts[0]) and the gate-ref push and the mirror stage are outside the module.

ServerSwitch holds the server switch and its rollback window: ServerSwitch backs the target up to <target>.prev and copies the candidate over the target, then writes <target>.switch.json when rollback is on (a crash between the copy and the state write leaves the switch without a window); a land pass fault (exit 2) in the window rolls back and removes the state, past the deadline the state is removed and the switch is permanent, and a refusal (exit 1) never rolls back; ServerRollback restores by hand. Four invariants (TargetIsAKnownBinary, RollbackOnlyInWindow, AtMostOneAutoRollbackPerSwitch, NoRollbackOnAHookRefusal) and three reversed witnesses (nodeadline, keepstate, hookfault). Since v1.2.13 the model carries the seat's hook: a restart drops it (SwitchRestart), the seat hooks in again (SeatHooksIn), and a land the hook gate refuses before it acts (LandHookRefused) is a wait, never a fault, so it never rolls the switch back; only a land let through by the gate and failed counts. It models two facts worth naming: a second switch inside the window overwrites .prev with the first candidate, and a switch with no prior target writes a state whose Previous is missing, so every failure in the window errors.
Several providers, the all-out stop, the friend exception.
Finished by the next verb, marked stuck or abandoned.
The flight, the NOpStuck judgment past LandDeadline, the landed-ancestry check.

ReadVerdict holds the readers' verdict on a worker's finish (TickVerdicts, readVerdict) to the accept's count (standingReads: the readers table and the fleet table's read cards, retired ones with an empty row included, one a reader by the reader field): OkOnlyWhenAcceptable, AcceptedNeverFailed and AcceptedWorkCountsOk (an accepted card's work comes to count ok in its worker's done), at Need 1 and 2, with the reversed witness BugReadersOnly (the readers table alone, keyed by the row, as before 2026-10-11) breaking AcceptedWorkCountsOk. The heavy overrule and a fleet read after the accept are modelled: the verdict follows the accept (OkOnlyWhenAcceptedOrAcceptable, AcceptedOnReadsNeverFailed).

DoneRecord holds the done record: its cursor over the epoch's log, its epoch and the stats reset's mark, with ticks that read again after a stale write. NoDoubleCount (where shows at most the distinct completions after the mark), CaughtUpIsTruth, ResetShowsZero and ClearStartsAgain hold; BugNoDedup breaks NoDoubleCount and BugKeepEpoch breaks ClearStartsAgain.

LandLedgers holds the ledger-only landing (lander-resolves-ledger-conflicts, v1.2.13): a merge whose every conflicted path is a shared ledger (cardgen.LedgerInPaths) is resolved and lands once its checks pass; a conflict outside the set is refused as before. It proves CodeConflictNeverLands, OnlyCheckedResolutionsLand, NoLedgerOnlyRefusal, LedgerOnlyLands and AllDecided, with three reversed witnesses: anyconflict (a code conflict resolved and landed), nocheck (a resolution the checks refused lands) and refuseledgers (the lander before v1.2.13, which refused a ledger-only conflict). The per-ledger merges (by key, by form) are functions tested in Go, not modelled.
